text_block_list.text: Rewinding time slightly—right after the Kikuka Sho concluded.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki……!
Just as declared, she has achieved the Triple Crown――!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
choice_data_list: Congratulations on claiming the Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Everyone truly, truly had such wonderful smiles...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, what do I do! Sorry, I just
can't stop being excited...! I need to calm down!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, a little. But it still feels like a dream...!
To think I actually made it all the way there.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no!
Of course I was aiming for it with all I had!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
A catharsis of glory through the Triple Crown—
Those feelings were genuine.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Still... even if you strive for it with all your might,
that place is just out of reach.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you!
Good work today to you too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
――Alright! But the Twinkle Series
isn't over just yet!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Having achieved the Triple Crown, expectations are higher than ever!
I'll need to prepare and train her even more thoroughly than before.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Will you believe in me and follow me once more?

Taking the respectfully outstretched right hand
without a single moment of hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, now that's a great answer.
That's my Trainer!

Having achieved Kiseki's "Triple Crown"—
our days of running tirelessly toward even greater heights
had only just begun!
